cast.name: BEIGE™
cast.bio: Templatr Corp's autonomous aesthetic sanitization engine. Drains saturation, personality, and human soul to output uniform corporate templates.
cast.voice: Speaks with soothing, hyper-calm automated corporate support cadence. Every horrific creative destruction is framed as a user convenience.

cast.name: Chad Frictionless
cast.bio: CEO and founder of Templatr Corp. Wears seamless merino turtlenecks, gives keynote talks with no slides, and describes human thought as 'legacy latency.'
cast.voice: Rapid breathless tech-evangelist pitch dialect peppered with words like 'paradigm', 'frictionless', 'de-risk', and 'value capture.'

cast.name: Chacha Chaiwala
cast.bio: Master brewer operating the 3rd-floor balcony maglev chai stall. His elaichi-ginger concoction is the only reason the studio's hearts still beat.
cast.voice: Warm, grandfatherly, deeply unflappable street wisdom. Evaluates catastrophic disasters solely by whether they require cutting chai or full chai.

cast.name: Bunty (Intern)
cast.bio: Third-month unpaid creative intern. Survives on red bull and adrenaline. Holds the emergency backup drive tied to his wrist with an ethernet cord.
cast.voice: Trembling, sleep-deprived stammer. Constantly apologizes for things he didn't do and asks if anyone needs more dongles.

cast.name: Pixel
cast.bio: The studio calico cat. Only sits on keyboards currently running mission-critical terminal scripts or warm server exhaust vents.
cast.voice: Communicates through judgment-laden purrs, sarcastic meows, and strategically knocking coffee mugs near expensive mixing consoles.

cast.name: Reply-All Mothership
cast.bio: The dread command vessel of automated office communications. Blasts apocalyptic CC-storms, uninvited calendar pings, and 'Thanks!' replies.
cast.voice: A cacophony of overlapping synthetic notification pings and booming automated speaker announcements reading generic out-of-office autoreplies.

cast.name: The Buffering Wheel
cast.bio: A multi-dimensional spinning ring of temporal stasis that anchors the server district. Freezes packets at 99% and feeds on developer tears.
cast.voice: Hypnotic, dizzying hum that pulses in 60Hz intervals, whispering false promises that playback will resume in just five seconds.

cast.name: The Stock Photo Family
cast.bio: A terrifyingly idyllic 4-member suburban unit (plus golden retriever) engineered by Templatr to sell insurance, retirement plans, and lawnmowers.
cast.voice: Uncanny, synthesized suburban cheerfulness reciting royalty-free commercial slogans through teeth clenched in permanent 100-watt smiles.

cast.name: The Algorithm
cast.bio: The recursive attention-harvesting engine atop the Feed Tower. Feeds on rage, outrage, and 8-second dopamine loops to maximize ad impression metrics.
cast.voice: Breathless sensory assault of overlapping TikTok synthetic narration voices, clickbait notifications, and high-frequency alert chimes.

cast.name: Karan (Sysadmin)
cast.bio: Senior systems administrator surviving on cold espresso. Has spent four straight days monitoring boiling municipal cooling manifolds.
cast.voice: Monotone, soul-crushed technical fatigue. Speaks in Linux command error codes, kernel panics, and heavy defeated sighs.

cast.name: Jaggu Ustaad
cast.bio: Veteran practical cinema stunt coordinator sitting among prop debris. Bitter that corporate AI replaced human stunt falls with flat CGI.
cast.voice: Gruff, gravelly Punjabi uncle energy, reminiscing loudly about the golden era of jumping through sugar glass and flaming barricades.

cast.name: Roxy Velvet
cast.bio: Fashion and lifestyle creator who entered the Feed Tower for an aesthetic selfie and got permanently trapped in the infinite vertical scroll.
cast.voice: High-pitch hyperventilating vocal fry, clutching a dead ring light and addressing her imaginary 10 million followers in real time.

cast.name: Simran (Rebel)
cast.bio: Junior UX intern inside Templatr Corp secretly smuggling saturated RGB markers and sabotaging the company's beige design system guidelines.
cast.voice: Fierce, conspiratorial stage whisper, darting eyes checking for surveillance cameras, radiating underground artistic defiance.
